lines.5: 「Despite having a name like Otome, you woke me from a peaceful sleep with a flying kick today, didn't you?」
lines.6: 「Because you vanished without a word! You never called for me to stop, so I kept running in silence!」
lines.7: 「Can you imagine how I felt when I realized I had passed through Tokyo and reached Saitama?」
lines.9: 「Then you shall have no lunch today.」
lines.10: Honestly, I wanted anything but rice balls, so that sounded more like a favor.
lines.11: A few more meals of nothing but rice balls and I might start feeling brainwashed.
lines.12: 「I am tired... Two hours of sleep truly is not enough.」
lines.13: Otome was smart, but was she also an idiot?
lines.14: Not that I could ever say that aloud.
lines.18: For some reason, she handed me a lunch box.
lines.19: 「Going without lunch is difficult for someone your age... Out of mercy, I shall spare you that punishment.」
lines.22: She chose the strangest times to be kind.
